fields.title: Write a Requirement
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: product comparison screen, up to 4 products, data from catalog, prices, and reviews. Write the Performance section across five parts and suggest two automated checks.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: scenario — opening a screen with 4 products; metric — time to interactivity; p95 <= 1.6 s on a median device over 4G, up to 500 RPS; backend part p95 <= 500 ms; number of network requests <= 3; failure blocks release. Automated checks: number of network requests on open and backend time under load test. Trap — failing to specify the number of products: time depends on it linearly.
